selection: Purposive 20-organization public-source stress cohort: 17 data-center developers/operators, 3 generation infrastructure owners. Not a representative production coverage sample.

global_rules.identity: Labels identify source-supported organizations only; no invented canonical UUIDs. Runtime binding must use existing identity machinery.
global_rules.temporal_scope: Facts are source-as-of historical assertions, not independently verified current operation or employment.
global_rules.commissioning: All20 abstain absent documented test blocks, load fractions and concurrency; equipment/generation/nameplate MW alone insufficient.
global_rules.contacts: Source-supported named functional leaders are historical at publication; current employment/decision authority and professional methods unverified unless separately evidenced. No emails fabricated.
global_rules.missingness: capacity[] empty means not stated in bounded source except DigitalRealty partial retrieval; do not score missingness as extraction error.
global_rules.date_precision: Approximate/quarter/year values never become invented exact days.
global_rules.source_date: null remains unknown/conflicting; metadata modified dates not publication dates.
